hook.en: In ∫2x sin(x² + 1) dx, the 2x is exactly the derivative of the x² + 1 inside the sine. Recognising such pairs turns a hard integral into an easy one.
hook.kn: ∫2x sin(x² + 1) dx ಯಲ್ಲಿ 2x ಎಂಬುದು sin ಒಳಗಿನ x² + 1 ನ ಅವಕಲಜವೇ. ಇಂತಹ ಜೋಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದರೆ ಕಠಿಣ ಸಮಾಕಲನ ಸುಲಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: In ∫2x sin(x² + 1) dx, the 2x is exactly the derivative of the x² + 1 inside the sine. Recognising such pairs turns a hard integral into an easy one.
narration.kn: ∫2x sin(x² + 1) dx ಯಲ್ಲಿ 2x ಎಂಬುದು sin ಒಳಗಿನ x² + 1 ನ ಅವಕಲಜವೇ. ಇಂತಹ ಜೋಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದರೆ ಕಠಿಣ ಸಮಾಕಲನ ಸುಲಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: If the integrand has the form $f(g(x))\,g'(x)$, put $t = g(x)$, so $dt = g'(x)\,dx$, and $\int f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx = \int f(t)\,dt$. Remember to write the answer back in terms of $x$. In particular $\int \frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}dx = \log|f(x)| + C$.
body.kn: ಸಮಾಕಲ್ಯ f(g(x)) g′(x) ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ t = g(x), dt = g′(x)dx ಎಂದು ಆದೇಶಿಸಿ. ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ x ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.

points.en: ∫sec x dx = log|sec x + tan x| + C

narration.en: If the integrand is a function of g of x times g dash of x, substitute t equals g of x. The derivative of the denominator over the denominator integrates to log of the denominator.
narration.kn: ಸಮಾಕಲ್ಯ f(g(x)) g′(x) ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ t = g(x), dt = g′(x)dx ಎಂದು ಆದೇಶಿಸಿ. ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ x ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.

title.en: Spot the inside and its derivative

say.en: In 2 x cos x squared, the inside function is x squared, and its derivative 2 x is sitting right outside. That is the signal to substitute.
Put t equals x squared, so d t equals 2 x d x. The integral becomes cos t d t.
A special case: if the top is the derivative of the bottom, the answer is a log. So tan x integrates to log sec x.
Squares of sine and cosine are first reduced with the double-angle identity.

narration.en: On the board: Spot the inside and its derivative.

body.en: Powers and products of sines and cosines are first reduced with identities: $\sin^2 x = \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{2}$, $\cos^2 x = \frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2}$, $2\sin A\cos B = \sin(A + B) + \sin(A - B)$.
body.kn: sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2, cos²x = (1 + cos 2x)/2 ಮುಂತಾದ ನಿತ್ಯಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಳಗೊಳಿಸಿ.

narration.en: Squares and products of sines and cosines are first rewritten using double-angle and product formulas, and then integrated term by term.
narration.kn: sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2, cos²x = (1 + cos 2x)/2 ಮುಂತಾದ ನಿತ್ಯಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಳಗೊಳಿಸಿ.

title.en: Area of 2x cos x² by substitution

caption.en: Yellow: the integrand 2x cos(x²). Green: its antiderivative sin(x²). The area from 0 to b equals sin(b²).

tryThis.en: Find b where the area first reaches its largest value 1. (Hint: b² = π/2.)
Past b ≈ 1.77, the yellow curve goes negative. What does the area do?

narration.en: Move b. The signed area under the yellow curve from zero to b is just the height of the green curve at b.

heading.en: Derivative of the bottom on the top

body.en: Before anything else, check whether the numerator is (a multiple of) the derivative of the denominator. If so, the answer is that multiple times log|denominator|.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we reveal the answers.

points.en: Substitute t = g(x) when g′(x) appears as a factor.
points.kn: g′(x) ಅಪವರ್ತನವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಾಗ t = g(x) ಆದೇಶಿಸಿ.

points.en: Reduce sin²x, cos²x with double-angle identities first.
points.kn: sin²x, cos²x ಗಳನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ದ್ವಿಗುಣ ಕೋನ ನಿತ್ಯಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಸರಳಗೊಳಿಸಿ.

narration.en: Recap. Substitute t = g(x) when g′(x) appears as a factor. ∫f′(x)/f(x) dx = log|f(x)| + C. Reduce sin²x, cos²x with double-angle identities first.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. g′(x) ಅಪವರ್ತನವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಾಗ t = g(x) ಆದೇಶಿಸಿ. ∫f′(x)/f(x) dx = log|f(x)| + C. sin²x, cos²x ಗಳನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ದ್ವಿಗುಣ ಕೋನ ನಿತ್ಯಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಸರಳಗೊಳಿಸಿ.
